title: The US and Iran sign a nuclear deal with no extensive strikes first
html:
Proposition

The US and Iran sign a nuclear deal with no extensive strikes first

By May 18, 2027 the United States and Iran agree a nuclear deal that limits Iran's programme in exchange for sanctions relief, without a new round of extensive US strikes before it.

When
Any time to May 18, 2027
Known from
US and Iranian government statements; consensus of major news reporting
Forecast12.7%
Upper bound21.0%
0%100%
Market range

How it’s set

Rationale

Kalshi asks a deal before July 1, 2027. May 18 is 180 of the 224 days to that deadline, and Kalshi's own ladder puts 0.095 of its 0.205 before March 1, so about three quarters of deals by July land by May 18; of those, I take 0.85 to come without an extensive round of strikes first. 0.75 x 0.85 is about 0.62.
